question: Where is the well (world-space coordinates), and can you select an NPC definition for one of Maren, Pip, or Odd so I can assign its patrol route?
answer: Maren. Centre a small loop of three or four points on the Village Well (its position is in the index slice; if it is not, use a 3 m radius around (0, 0, -1.9)), +Z north, metres.
